question: Birju Maharaj was a noted dancer of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Birju Maharaj** was a noted dancer of **Kathak.**
 
• **Kathak **is one of the major **classical dance** forms of India and is characterized by intricate** footwork, graceful movements, storytelling, and expressive facial expressions.**
 
• **Birju Maharaj,** whose full name is Pandit Birju Maharaj, is a highly acclaimed** Kathak dancer, choreographer, and guru (teacher) who has made significant contributions to the art form.**
 
• He comes from a long lineage of **Kathak dancers **and has achieved international recognition for his mastery and innovative approach to **Kathak dance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a classical Indian dance form that originated in the state of **Tamil Nadu,** characterized by intricate footwork, expressive gestures, rhythmic movements, and storytelling.
 
• **Manipuri** is a classical Indian dance form from the northeastern state of **Manipur**, known for its graceful movements, fluid body postures, use of intricate hand gestures, and vibrant costumes.
 
• **Sattriya** is a classical Indian dance form from the state of **Assam,** characterized by its devotional themes, rhythmic footwork, graceful movements, and rich cultural heritage.
